en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large, multi‑storey hotel or sanatorium‑style building situated on a forested hill. Dense coniferous trees surround the main structure, which has a long, rectangular form with many windows and a prominent central entrance. In the foreground, rooftops of smaller buildings are partly visible among the trees. The overall style suggests an early‑20th‑century mountain or spa resort. There is a small printed caption at the bottom left of the image.
